description: Astrocare is an interactive 3D web tool helping astronauts monitor health on long-duration space missions. It combats microgravity, radiation, and isolation by tracking vitals like heart rate, blood pressure, sleep, and mood. Featuring a clickable human model, dynamic charts, and alerts, it enables crew members to self-assess wellbeing. With trend analysis and gamified task tracking, Astrocare ensures crews stay healthy and mission-ready for voyages to Mars or lunar outposts.
